Meet Recall

Ask in plain words.
Recall answers from a real page in your notes.

You type the question, like you would to a classmate. Recall finds the exact paragraph, answers with the source attached, and offers to quiz you on it before you forget. It keeps score, too.

# bio-201-mitosis
🧑
You2:41 PM
what's the difference between mitosis and meiosis again? we have a quiz tmrw
✺
Recall2:41 PM
Mitosis makes 2 identical cells for growth and repair. Meiosis makes 4 genetically different cells for reproduction, with one extra division.
Source · Ch. 4, p. 112 · your notes
"Meiosis I separates homologous chromosomes; meiosis II separates sister chromatids."

yes do it

How it works

One thread, the whole session.

Drop in a photo of your notes or a PDF of the reading. Ask what you don't understand, get quizzed on what you said you knew, and watch Recall flag the parts you keep missing. Nothing gets lost between apps.

What a search bar can't do

Textbooks explain. Recall quizzes.

Questions

Fair questions.

A study chat that already knows your notes. The difference from a regular chatbot is that you upload the material once, and the same context stays in every question and quiz after that.

Your notes are stored to your account only and are never used to train a model. Deleting a set removes its quizzes and flashcards along with it.

Recall is free to start, with unlimited uploads on the free plan and higher usage limits on paid plans. No card required to sign up.

PDFs, slide decks, plain text, and photos of handwritten or printed pages. If you can photograph it, Recall can usually read it.

No setup needed — Recall works out of the box. If you'd rather use your own API key for higher limits, that's supported too.

No — it reads the textbook you already have and turns it into something you can talk to and be quizzed by. The source stays the source.
